about: Help-center eval: Microsoft's support sites, where answers sit several levels deep or behind the site's search. Every site × every goal, from the site's home page. A run succeeds when the navigator reports Reached and the final URL or title contains one of the goal's keywords (and none of `avoid`: a search results page whose query holds the keyword is not the article). When the navigator hands back for text, the eval types the goal's `query` and Enter, as the calling agent would, up to twice. Run with `aibrowse eval navigator --suite evals/microsoft-help.json`.

bluetooth.goal: the Microsoft support article on fixing Bluetooth problems in Windows

default_browser.goal: the Microsoft support article on how to change the default web browser in Windows

recover_account.goal: the Microsoft support article on how to recover a Microsoft account you can't sign in to

store_refund.goal: the Microsoft support article on how to return or get a refund for something bought from the Microsoft Store

outlook_shortcuts.goal: the list of keyboard shortcuts for Outlook
